newsitem.title: USA: Computer Sciences names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Computer Sciences names new chairman.

text.p: Computer Sciences Corp said on Monday that Van Honeycutt, the company's president and chief executive officer, would succeed William Hoover as chairman of the board, effective March 28, 1997.
Honeycutt, 51, would continue as president and CEO and Hoover, 66, would remain on the board and serve on its executive committee, the company said.
Honeycutt assumed the roles of president and chief operating officer in 1993. He became CEO in March 1995, and was not replaced as COO.
March 28 is the end of the company's fiscal year.
